purpose: V614 physical-watt resource screen; separate from legacy normalized-budget manifests

channels.source: Gill Instruments GMX500 datasheet: 25 mA standard and 400 mA total with heating at 12 V
channels.rule: on at air temperature <= -25 C or dew-point margin <= 1 C with air temperature <= -5 C; off at air temperature >= -23 C and margin >= 2 C

channels.source: OTT Parsivel2 documentation: 50 W default sensor-head heating; 100 W adjustable capacity
channels.rule: on at air temperature <= -20 C or dew-point margin <= 1 C with surface temperature <= -5 C; off at air temperature >= -18 C and dew-point margin >= 2 C
